# pet-backend — Go vs Hasura routing (llms.txt)

## Stack

Go business-logic service + Hasura GraphQL engine + PostgreSQL (single source of
truth). Money is integer minor units end-to-end (`common.Bigint` travels as a JSON
string; Hasura runs with `STRINGIFY_NUMERIC_TYPES=true`). FX math via
`common.ConvertToMinor` with each currency's `minor_unit` — never floats.

## Golden rule

- **Go Action** when money moves or a derived table must change atomically
  (`balance_ledger`, `holdings`, `budget_progress`, `daily_category_summary`).
- **Hasura GraphQL** for plain CRUD on simple entities and all reads/subscriptions.

## Route table

| Operation | Via | Endpoint / object |
|---|---|---|
| Register / login / refresh | Go | `POST /actions/auth/register`, `/login`, `/refresh` |
| Create account | Go | `POST /actions/account/create` (`type` ∈ catalog `account.accounts_type`, optional `initial_amount` opening balance) |
| List/get/archive accounts | Hasura | `account.accounts`, `v_active_accounts`; `account.accounts_type` read-only |
| Create/update/delete transaction, transfer | Go | `POST /actions/tx/create`, `/transfer`, `/update`, `/delete` |
| Reclassify transaction (category/description only) | Hasura | `tx.transactions` update `category_id`, `description` |
| Categories, tags | Hasura | full CRUD; `tx.system_categories` (global template) read-only |
| Budgets, budget limits | Hasura | full CRUD; `budget_progress` is read-only (event worker writes it) |
| Create trade | Go | `POST /actions/invest/trade` |
| Portfolios, assets, holdings, trades, prices | Hasura | portfolios/assets CRUD, rest read-only |
| Start import | Go | `POST /actions/import/start` |
| Import jobs / raw rows | Hasura | jobs read, `raw_rows` read-only |
| Fetch FX rates, rebuild analytics | Go | `POST /actions/fx/fetch`, `/actions/analytics/rebuild` |
| Rates, summaries, snapshots | Hasura | read-only |

## Constraints agents must obey

1. Never write `balance_minor`, `balance_ledger`, `holdings`, `budget_progress`,
   `price_history`, or `refresh_tokens` directly — Go or the event worker owns them.
2. Never set `amount_minor`, `account_id`, `to_account_id`, `kind`, or `deleted_at`
   on `tx.transactions` via Hasura: the `app.via_action` guard trigger rejects it.
   Use the tx Actions.
3. Transfers require `to_account_id`, `category_id = NULL`, distinct accounts.
   `kind = transfer` rows are immutable (no update endpoint).
4. Every mutating Go handler runs in `db.WithSerializable` (retries `40001`/`40P01`);
   closures contain only DB work — side effects (JWT issue, notifications, HTTP)
   go after `COMMIT`.
5. Balance reversals sum `account.balance_ledger` by `ref_id`; never recompute from
   current FX rates. Lock multiple accounts in ascending id order. New accounts
   open with `balance_minor = initial_amount` plus an opening ledger row
   (`reason='adjustment'`) when nonzero.
6. Account `type` must exist in `account.accounts_type` (`debit card`, `cash`,
   `deposit`, `broker`, `credit card`, `credit`, `debt`, `crypto`, `saving`).
   Register seeds categories by copying `tx.system_categories` (no `is_system`
   column on `tx.categories`).
6. Validate currency with `common.ValidCurrency` before inserts; scope by org with
   `common.ActingOrg`; cross-org access returns `NotFound`.
7. Handlers follow the `Handler{pool, log}` + `NewHandler(pool, cfg, log)` shape;
   errors via `common.Wrap`/`BadRequest`/`NotFound` + `WriteError`/`WriteJSON`.
8. Amounts over the API are string-backed `Bigint` (`"12345"`); parse server-side
   with `strconv.ParseInt` / `Bigint.Int64`.
9. Cron/event endpoints (`/cron/*`, `/events/*`) are for Hasura and the LISTEN
   worker — do not call them as CRUD.
10. Docs: `ARCHITECTURE.md` §8 is the flow spec; per-package `internal/*/README.md`
    is the entry-point reference; when prose conflicts with `../db/*.sql`, trust SQL.
11. Schema changes ship as `migrations/NNNN_name.up/down.sql` and the matching
    `db_schema.sql` baseline edit (docker init runs the baseline, migrate runs
    the delta); Hasura metadata (`hasura/metadata/.../tables/`) tracks renames.

## Module map

`auth` identity/JWT · `accounts` account shells · `transactions` money movement ·
`budgets` limits + spend progress · `invest` portfolios/trades/valuation ·
`imports` CSV/OFX parse-dedup-map · `fx` rate loading · `analytics` read models ·
`events` LISTEN worker · `common` identity/currency/money/errors/middleware ·
`config` env · `db` pool + serializable retry · `observability` Prometheus metrics.
